item.title: Maria Bartiromo leaves Fox
item.description: Fox News Media announced Thursday that longtime Fox Business host Maria Bartiromo is departing the network, a surprise move.

item.title: Pentagon official confirms Anthropic remains on blacklist despite Lutnick remarks
item.description: A top Pentagon official stated Thursday that Anthropic is still seen as a supply chain risk, one day after Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick made comments suggesting otherwise.

item.title: Major AI services experience widespread outage
item.description: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are all down Thursday morning, according to Downdetector. The outage is affecting users across multiple platforms.

item.title: Some Fed officials urge caution on rate hikes
item.description: Following Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, markets anticipated a rate hike in mid-September, but some officials are signaling a slower approach.
